entries.title: Ezekiel 37:1
segments: ¶The hand of the LORD came upon me and brought me out in the Spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley; and it [was] full of bones.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:2
segments: Then He caused me to pass by them all around, and behold, [there were] very many in the open valley; and indeed [they were] very dry.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:3
segments: And He said to me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" So I answered, "O Lord GOD, You know."

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:4
segments: Again He said to me, "Prophesy to these bones, and say to them, 'O dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:5
segments: 'Thus says the Lord GOD to these bones: "Surely I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:6
segments: "I will put sinews on you and bring flesh upon you, cover you with skin and put breath in you; and you shall live. Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD."'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:7
segments: So I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and suddenly a rattling; and the bones came together, bone to bone.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:8
segments: Indeed, as I looked, the sinews and the flesh came upon them, and the skin covered them over; but [there was] no breath in them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:9
segments: Also He said to me, "Prophesy to the breath, prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live."'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:10
segments: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and breath came into them, and they lived, and stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great army.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:11
segments: Then He said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. They indeed say, 'Our bones are dry, our hope is lost, and we ourselves are cut off!'

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:12
segments: "Therefore prophesy and say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, O My people, I will open your graves and cause you to come up from your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:13
segments: "Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O My people, and brought you up from your graves.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:14
segments: "I will put My Spirit in you, and you shall live, and I will place you in your own land. Then you shall know that I, the LORD, have spoken [it] and performed [it]," says the LORD.'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:15
segments: ¶Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:16
segments: "As for you, son of man, take a stick for yourself and write on it: 'For Judah and for the children of Israel, his companions.' Then take another stick and write on it, 'For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and [for] all the house of Israel, his companions.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:17
segments: "Then join them one to another for yourself into one stick, and they will become one in your hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:18
segments: "And when the children of your people speak to you, saying, 'Will you not show us what you [mean] by these?' -

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:19
segments: "say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Surely I will take the stick of Joseph, which [is] in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions; and I will join them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in My hand."'

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:20
segments: "And the sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:21
segments: "Then say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Surely I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, wherever they have gone, and will gather them from every side and bring them into their own land;

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:22
segments: "and I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king over them all; they shall no longer be two nations, nor shall they ever be divided into two kingdoms again.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:23
segments: "They shall not defile themselves anymore with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will deliver them from all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. Then they shall be My people, and I will be their God.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:24
segments: "David My servant [shall be] king over them, and they shall all have one shepherd; they shall also walk in My judgments and observe My statutes, and do them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:25
segments: "Then they shall dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob My servant, where your fathers dwelt; and they shall dwell there, they, their children, and their children's children, forever; and My servant David [shall be] their prince forever.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:26
segments: "Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them, and it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary in their midst forevermore.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:27
segments: "My tabernacle also shall be with them; indeed I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:28
segments: "The nations also will know that I, the LORD, sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary is in their midst forevermore."'"
